## Change

Describe the user-visible or operational outcome and its bounded context.

## Verification

- [ ] Narrow automated tests pass
- [ ] Lint and static analysis pass
- [ ] Authorization and failure paths were exercised when applicable
- [ ] Data migrations are backward-compatible and rollback behavior is understood
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, or generated artifacts were committed
- [ ] Observability and runbook impact was reviewed

## Deployment risk

State the rollout, monitoring signal, and rollback trigger. Use “none” only when the change cannot affect a deployed runtime.
